title: The autopilot container is built from a pinned file and passes Stage C of the test plan
goal: Following kb/_self/autopilot-container.md and the operator's answers to this item's gates: a Dockerfile with digests and checksums read from their sources by a person, the start/stop/status wrapper that maps runner commands to docker exec inside ONE container, the egress proxy on an internal network, the secret files (never in docker inspect), and Stage C of kb/_self/autopilot-test.md passing on this Mac with the measured limits written back to the plan. Edits of autopilot.py, the wrapper and the settings are agents-rule and push work: an operator-present session does them, never a headless run. The resolved unconfirmed points of the plan (docker exec -d parentage against bl_procs, lock liveness in one pid namespace, headless trust and MCP approvals, glab token scope, claude host list, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID in child_env) are each checked and written back.
